gates.name: production docs build
gates.reason: ./docs.ps1 is not present in this checkout — per CLAUDE.md it is installer-generated (by Invoke-SetupDocs), not committed, and was not found at the repository root. Docker itself is available locally, but without docs.ps1 the production Docusaurus build (onBrokenLinks: 'throw') cannot be invoked. The corresponding PR check 'Verify Documentation Build' on PR #342 (head cb5c6c28b403a2f020851733d816f0030449f800) reports pass (https://github.com/The-Running-Dev/SubZeroDev.GameEngine/actions/runs/32282997783/job/96165860675).

gates.name: host tests
gates.reason: dotnet test src/host/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests/SubZeroDev.GameEngine.Host.Tests.csproj fails during NuGet restore with NU1301: 'Response status code does not indicate success: 401 (Unauthorized)' against https://nuget.pkg.github.com/The-Running-Dev/download/subzerodev.platform.hosting/index.json. SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting is published from the sibling SubZeroDev.Platform repository via GitHub Packages, and the local environment has no cross-repo read:packages credential configured (CI supplies this via the REGISTRY_TOKEN secret, per .github/workflows/host-image.yml). Cannot run locally without that credential.

gates.name: host image smoke
gates.reason: The same host-image.yml smoke job restores SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting as its first real step (via 'Test the host', which runs the same dotnet test as the 'host tests' gate) before building/running/smoke-testing the Docker image, and that restore requires the REGISTRY_TOKEN cross-repo GitHub Packages credential that is not configured locally — same root cause as 'host tests'. The corresponding PR check 'Build, run, and smoke the image' on PR #342 (head cb5c6c28b403a2f020851733d816f0030449f800) reports pass (https://github.com/The-Running-Dev/SubZeroDev.GameEngine/actions/runs/32282997774/job/96165861089).
